}}'''Azzara din Karak''' is a [[Sea Folk]] [[Windfinder]].

== Strength and Abilities ==

She has a strength in the One Power of {{opsl|24}}, which would make her quite high compared to most Aes Sedai.

She is strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]] and learned the weave while in [[Caemlyn]] with [[Elayne]].

== Activities ==

After the bargain about the [[Bowl of the Winds]] Azzara accompanied [[Renaile]] to the [[Tarasin Palace]], and then to the [[Kin]]'s farm. Because she was one of the strongest available among the Windfinders in [[Ebou Dar]], she was chosen for the use of the Bowl, but then she has to step down because strongest channelers as [[Reanne]] were available, so Azzara simply observed the use of the ''[[ter'angreal]]''; then she fled to [[Caemlyn]] along [[Elayne]] and her companions, when the [[Seanchan]] attack to [[Altara]] was in act.

It is not stated if later Azzara stayed in Caemlyn along [[Chanelle]] or if she went to Tear along [[Zaida]].
